title: Naringenin protects against septic cardiomyopathy in mice by targeting HIF-1alpha.
authors: Pan, Jiajia; Meng, Lijun; Li, Rujun; Wang, Zicheng; Yuan, Wenjie; Li, Yucheng; Chen, Lin; Shen, Qinhao; Liu, Weili; Zhu, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柚皮素通过靶向HIF-1alpha保护脓毒症心肌病，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Myocardial dysfunction is a prevalent complication of sepsis (septic cardiomyopathy) with a high mortality rate and limited therapeutic options. Naringenin, a natural flavonoid compound with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, holds promise as a potential treatment for sepsis-induced myocardial dysfunction. This study investigated the pharmacological effects of naringenin on septic cardiomyopathy. In vivo and in vitro experiments demonstrated that naringenin improved cardiomyocyte damage. Network pharmacology and database analysis revealed that HIF-1alpha is a key target protein of naringenin. Elevated expression of HIF-1alpha was observed in damaged cardiomyocytes, and the HIF-1alpha inhibitor effectively protected against LPS-induced cardiomyocyte damage. Molecular docking studies confirmed the direct binding between naringenin and HIF-1alpha protein. Importantly, our findings demonstrated that naringenin did not provide additional attenuation of cardiomyocyte injury on the biases of HIF-1alpha inhibitor treatment. In conclusion, this study proves that naringenin protects against septic cardiomyopathy through HIF-1alpha signaling. Naringenin is a promising therapeutic candidate for treating septic cardiomyopathy.
abstract_zh: 心肌功能障碍是脓毒症（脓毒性心肌病）的常见并发症，具有高死亡率且治疗选择有限。柚皮素（Naringenin）是一种具有抗炎和抗氧化特性的天然黄酮类化合物，有望成为治疗脓毒症诱导心肌功能障碍的潜在药物。本研究探讨了柚皮素对脓毒性心肌病的药理作用。体内和体外实验表明，柚皮素改善了心肌细胞损伤。网络药理学和数据库分析揭示，HIF-1alpha是柚皮素的关键靶蛋白。在受损心肌细胞中观察到HIF-1alpha表达升高，且HIF-1alpha抑制剂有效保护了LPS诱导的心肌细胞损伤。分子对接研究证实了柚皮素与HIF-1alpha蛋白之间的直接结合。重要的是，我们的研究结果表明，在HIF-1alpha抑制剂治疗的基础上，柚皮素并未提供额外的心肌细胞损伤缓解作用。总之，本研究证明柚皮素通过HIF-1alpha信号通路保护脓毒性心肌病。柚皮素是治疗脓毒性心肌病的有前景的候选药物。
